products.title: New York Fuckery Thermal Construction Jacket
products.body_html:
The New York Fuckery Construction Jacket is a tribute to the city’s most permanent temporary condition: scaffolding that never comes down, jackhammers at 7:01am, cones that multiply overnight, and crews standing around a hole like it’s a sacred monument.

Inspired by official-looking uniforms and municipal authority, this jacket is a tribute to the Fuckery & bravery that goes behind each construction site. Respect to the construction crews, where the work is hard & the days are long. New York thanks you, it wouldn’t be NYC without the grueling men (some women) who built the city.

It’s for anyone who’s:

  • Walked an extra six blocks because “sidewalk closed”
  • Watched one guy work while five supervise
  • Heard “two more weeks” for the last two years

Built tough, worn daily, and stamped with Fuckery front and center—because if you live here long enough, you earn the right to laugh at it.

Details

  • Heavy-duty construction jacket built for daily wear
  • Structured fit with room to layer
  • Durable fabric meant to take abuse (just like the city)
  • Bold New York Fuckery graphic — official-looking, unofficially honest
  • PJ original artwork — satire, survival, and civic dysfunction

Materials-

- 9 oz., 100% polyester fleece

- 5 oz., lightweight 100% polyester mesh lining

Features-

- ANSI/ISEA 107 -2015 type R class 3 certified

- 2” reflective tape

- Nylon front zipper

- Double layered three-piece hood

- Oversized front pockets

- Knit cuffs and waistband

Specs & Sizing-

Sizes: M - 4XL

products.title: New York City Arteries Gasoline Jackets
products.body_html:
New York City Arteries was born on the Union Square L train platform, inspired by the giant subway map that once hung there. Walking past it daily, PJ found more than inspiration—those subway lines quite literally kept him alive. Selling prints & sketching underground built his independence, street smarts, & discipline in a way only New York could.

 

The design reshapes the NYC subway system into a human heart, with trains acting as blood pumping through the city’s veins—a tribute to the city’s pulse & survival.

 

The Gasoline Jacket is built for real use, not decoration. Heavy-duty construction, reinforced stitching, & rugged materials make it dependable in daily wear, cold weather, & unpredictable conditions. Designed with utility in mind, it delivers warmth without bulk, freedom of movement, & long-term durability—made to be worn hard & trusted everywhere.

The New York City Arteries embroidery is on the back, placed boldly at the center of the upper shoulders, with a PJ O’Rourke signature embroidery on the left chest & a smaller Arteries embroidery beneath it. Dense stitching & high thread count give the artwork lasting depth & presence.

Material-

- 12 oz. super-duty cotton duck

- Heavyweight fleece lined

Features-

- Pleated elbows and action back

- Two angled welt pockets

- Right-chest zipper pocket

- Three inside chest pockets

- Triple-needle stitched main seems

- Adjustable snap cuffs and side tabs

Sizes: S - 3XL

*Note: 4XL not available.

Care-

Dry clean or wash normally, but air dry (do not put in dryer).

Navy/ Brown collar

Black/ Black collar

products.title: New York Fuckery Heartland Hooded Coat
products.body_html:
The New York Fuckery Heartland Hooded Coat is built for the parts of the city that don’t run on schedules- or explanations. Sidewalks that fight back. Corners where the wind hits sideways. Days that start early & end with paperwork you didn’t ask for.

This is the jacket you wear while reading a cease & desist letter from the New York State Gaming Commission, standing in the cold, or strolling past the chess players at Union Square; watching strategy unfold while realizing the city will always test you, but rarely break you. Heavy, dependable, & unbothered, it’s rooted in classic American workwear & sharpened by real New York experience.

Quilt-lined for warmth, triple-stitched where it counts, & cut with room to move, this is heritage gear designed for modern fuckery: built to last longer than the arguments against it.

Made from 12 oz. super-duty 100% cotton duck with a heavyweight quilt-lined interior, this jacket delivers serious warmth, structure, & durability. Finished with a three-piece insulated hood, heavy-duty brass zipper, & triple-needle stitched seams, it’s designed to feel substantial, protective, & built to last.

products.title: Bronx Bombers Heartland Hooded Coats
products.body_html:
A heavy, premium hooded coat built with authority. Bronx Bombers draws from New York’s layered legacy; aviation grit, stadium nights, street mythology, & the kind of confidence that doesn’t announce itself. It’s a name loaded with history, worn here with restraint & purpose.

Constructed from 12 oz. super-duty 100% cotton duck with a heavyweight quilt-lined interior, this coat delivers real warmth, structure, & durability. A three-piece insulated hood, heavy-duty brass zipper, & triple-needle stitched seams give it a substantial, protective feel; built to handle cold, movement, & years of wear without compromise.

Thrown on at a frozen platform or walking out of the stadium after nightfall, it feels exactly right; breath hanging in the air, hands deep in pockets, the city moving fast around you. This is outerwear for stairwells, late trains, loading docks, & long winters; trusted when conditions are rough & confidence matters more than noise.

New York energy; armored, understated, & impossible to shake.

products.title: Layer Cake of NY Gasoline Jackets
products.body_html:
This jacket wears New York the way New York is built; layer by layer, under pressure, in constant motion.

The Layer Cake of New York artwork across the back is a full cross-section of the city; towers above, infrastructure & underground life exposed below. It’s not graphic decoration; it’s architectural storytelling. From first sketch to final stitch, PJ spent approximately 130 hours developing this design, obsessing over every layer, reference, & detail until the city read true.

Built from 12 oz. super-duty cotton duck & fully fleece lined, this Gasoline Jacket is made for real wear. Pleated elbows & an action back allow movement without restriction, while triple-needle stitched main seams reinforce every high-stress point. It’s structured, durable, & designed to age with character.

Utility is intentional & understated; two angled welt pockets, a right-chest zipper pocket, & three interior chest pockets keep essentials secure without clutter. Adjustable snap cuffs & side tabs let you fine-tune the fit depending on the season & the street.

This isn’t fashion for show; it’s infrastructure you can wear.

A city mapped, cut open, & rebuilt; 130 hours at a time.

products.title: New York Fuckery Flame Retardant Limited Edition Coat
products.body_html:
The New York Fuckery Flame Retardant Coat is the most heavy-duty, no-compromise jacket in the entire catalog; built for environments where failure isn’t cosmetic, it’s costly. Whether you’re bracing against a wind tunnel on the East River or standing in Alaska wondering why you agreed to this job, this jacket is designed to protect, insulate, & endure.

Flame-resistant from shell to lining & insulated with aramid throughout, this is serious gear for serious conditions. It’s made for heat, cold, sparks, & long hours; trusted when the work gets dangerous & the margins disappear. No styling tricks, no shortcuts; just proven materials & industrial-grade construction.

This is New York Fuckery at its most utilitarian: the top tier. The last layer you put on when everything else is negotiable-except safety.

Specs & Protection-

  • Flame-resistant shell: 6 oz./yd² Nomex® IIIA (93% Nomex® Aramid / 5% Kevlar® Aramid / 2% other fiber)
  • 100% Meta-Aramid lining for full-coverage flame resistance
  • 9.3 oz./yd² aramid insulation package for maximum warmth & protection
  • Heavy-duty separating brass zipper with Nomex® tape
  • Rib-knit collar, cuffs, & waistband to seal out cold & wind
  • Two large inset welted slash pockets
  • Left sleeve utility pocket
  • Industrial laundry (light soil) & home wash compatible

 

 

From New York to Alaska. Built for heat. Built for freezing cold, too. Built to last.

products.title: Apartments & Inflation Windbreaker
products.body_html:
Apartments & Inflation is a tongue-in-cheek parody of the New York City Department of Sanitation; because in this city, rising rent & rising prices feel like hazards you deal with daily. The familiar civic seal gets reworked into a wearable warning label, stamped right on your head for maximum visibility.

The ribbed knit delivers a classic, no-nonsense fit; structured, warm, & built for everyday wear. Available in bottle green, black, mustard yellow, & light grey, it covers the full New York spectrum; from workwear to winter uniform.

Made from 100% recycled polyester, this beanie literally gives trash a second life. Old plastic bottles, new purpose. Consider it sanitation with a sense of humor.

It’s sustainable, practical, & quietly sarcastic; just like surviving New York, heading over the Queensboro Bridge.

Details-

  • Ribbed knit construction for a snug, everyday fit
  • Available in bottle green, black, mustard yellow, & light grey
  • Made from 100% recycled polyester
  • Soft, durable, & cold-weather ready
  • Sustainability note; yes, it’s made from recycled bottles; because someone had to clean up the mess

products.title: Apartments & Inflation Heartland Hooded Coat
products.body_html:
The Apartments & Inflation Heartland Coat is a civic uniform for surviving modern New York; where rents rise faster than scaffolding & inflation makes yesterday’s dollar feel like loose change found in a laundromat dryer.

The oversized back patch reads like an official city seal no one voted for. A reworked caduceus twists through a brick apartment tower, wings spread like pigeons on payday, burning money overhead as rent climbs skyward. It’s public health, but for your bank account. Call it sanitation-inspired because somebody has to clean up the mess.

Cut from super-duty cotton duck with a quilted liner, this coat is built for cold walks, long waits, & the emotional weight of your monthly rent notification. Tough enough for garbage routes, resilient enough for inflation, & warm enough to make winter feel slightly less disrespectful.

This is outerwear for people who understand that rising costs are the real city skyline.

Details-

  • 12 oz. super-duty cotton duck shell
  • Heavyweight quilt-lined taffeta interior for serious warmth
  • Triple-needle stitched main seams (because everything else is falling apart)
  • Heavy-duty brass zipper built to outlast rent control
  • Three-piece insulated hood with drawstring
  • Pleated elbows & action back for movement on the job—or escaping landlords
  • Two front patch pockets
  • Three interior pockets for essentials, receipts, & inflation anxiety

Specs & Sizing:

Sizes: M - 4XL
